name: Sawaguchi Kouta
source:
The protagonist of this story.

He is the son of an engineer. His father's job requires him to transfer to a new school. He lives alone with his father and his mother died five years ago. He meets Jun at school and learns about "mama club" and decides to join.

He learns many things from Jun and despite his doubts he has sex with an unspecified number of women...
